narrative:
## Handover Summary — Headcount & Cost per FTE

Headcount roll-forward validated: hires, departures, transfers and open positions by month.

## Key Decisions
• Retention awards for two senior development finance directors
• +3 bridging underwriters to protect completion speed (about £330K a year)
• Savings operations hiring held flat while the online portal releases go live

## Recommendation for Operating Costs
Cost per FTE growth should stay below 4% in FY2027 for the cost-income ratio to reach 47.5%.

signals.title: Cost-income ratio improved to 48.8%
signals.excerpt: Administrative expenses £84.6M; FTEs 421 → 458; multi-year investment programme in digitisation and AI.
